title: Electrical Panel Upgrade
summary: Replace an outdated or overloaded electrical panel with a modern 200-amp service. We handle the permit, the PECO disconnect and reconnect, the inspection, and label every circuit when we're done.

title: Electrical Subpanel Installation
summary: Add circuits where you need them with a subpanel for a garage, basement, addition or workshop. We check your service capacity first, size the feeder properly and handle the permit and inspection.

title: Fuse Box Replacement
summary: Replace an old fuse box with a modern circuit breaker panel, or get a blown fuse changed safely. We make sure every fuse is the right size for its wire and upgrade the service when it's due.

title: Circuit Breaker Replacement
summary: Breakers that trip for no reason, feel hot or won't reset get diagnosed and replaced with the correct breaker for your panel. We find out why it failed before we swap it, so the problem doesn't come back.

title: AFCI Breaker Installation
summary: Arc-fault (AFCI) breakers detect the kind of sparking that starts electrical fires inside walls. We install them where code requires, add them during remodels, and track down the cause when one keeps tripping.

title: Home Rewiring
summary: Replace knob-and-tube, cloth-insulated or ungrounded wiring in older homes, room by room or all at once. We fish new cable through existing walls wherever we can, so you get new wiring with as little patching as possible.

title: Aluminum Wiring Replacement
summary: Homes wired with single-strand aluminum in the 1960s and 70s can overheat at outlets and switches. We make every connection safe with approved copper pigtail connectors, or replace the aluminum wiring entirely.

title: Whole House Surge Protection
summary: A surge protector installed at your electrical panel protects everything in the house, from the furnace and fridge to TVs and computers, against surges from lightning, the utility and your own large appliances.

title: Home Electrical Upgrades
summary: Bring an older home's electrical system up to how you live now: grounded three-prong outlets, more circuits, USB and GFCI outlets, better lighting and the capacity for modern appliances.

title: Kitchen Electrical Upgrade
summary: Wiring for kitchen remodels and updates: countertop circuits, GFCI outlets, island power, dedicated appliance circuits, induction and electric ranges, recessed and under-cabinet lighting.

title: Electrical Repair & Troubleshooting
summary: Dead outlets, tripping breakers, flickering lights, buzzing switches and half-working circuits, tracked down methodically and fixed properly. We find the cause instead of guessing, and explain what we found.

title: Electrical Inspections & Maintenance
summary: A thorough check of your home's electrical system: panel inspection, tightening connections, testing GFCI and AFCI protection, smoke and CO alarms, and a written list of anything that needs attention.

title: Electrical Code Corrections
summary: Fix the electrical items on a home inspection or municipal inspection report, from double-tapped breakers and missing GFCIs to open junction boxes and ungrounded outlets, with documentation for buyers and sellers.

title: New Construction Electrical
summary: Complete electrical for new homes, additions and major renovations: planning, temporary power, service installation, rough-in, trim-out and inspections, coordinated with your builder's schedule.

title: Electrical Wiring Installation
summary: New wiring for remodels, additions, attic and basement conversions: circuits, outlets, switches and lighting planned around how you'll use the space, installed to code and inspected.

title: Dedicated Circuit Installation
summary: Give appliances and equipment their own circuit so they stop tripping breakers: microwaves, refrigerators, freezers, sump pumps, space heaters, home offices, gym equipment and 240-volt tools.

title: Switch & Outlet Installation
summary: Add outlets where you need them and replace worn, loose, cracked or warm switches and outlets. We install USB and tamper-resistant outlets and fix the loose connections behind flickering switches.

title: Switch & Outlet Relocation
summary: Move outlets and switches to where they belong: behind a wall-mounted TV, clear of new cabinets, at the right height, or on the latch side of a door. Old boxes are closed up to code.

title: GFCI Outlet Installation
summary: Ground-fault (GFCI) protection for kitchens, bathrooms, laundry areas, garages, basements and outdoor outlets. We install GFCI outlets and breakers where code requires and fix GFCIs that won't reset.

title: Outdoor Outlet Installation
summary: Weather-resistant, GFCI-protected outdoor outlets with in-use covers for decks, patios, porches, holiday lights, landscape lighting transformers, pool equipment and yard tools.

title: Dimmer Switch Installation
summary: LED-compatible dimmers that dim smoothly without flicker or buzz, including smart dimmers, multi-location dimming and dimmers matched to your fixtures and bulbs.

title: Two-Way (3-Way) Switch Wiring
summary: Control a light from two or more places, such as the top and bottom of the stairs or both ends of a hallway. We add new switch locations and fix 3-way circuits that only work one way.

title: Ceiling Fan Installation
summary: Ceiling fans installed securely on fan-rated boxes, whether you're replacing a light fixture or adding a fan to a room with no ceiling wiring. Separate fan and light control, remotes and high-ceiling downrods.

title: Attic Fan Installation
summary: Powered attic ventilators wired with thermostat and humidistat control to move hot, humid air out of your attic. We install gable fans and wire roof-mounted units, and repair fans that have stopped working.

title: Appliance Wiring
summary: Circuits and hookups for electric and induction ranges, cooktops, wall ovens, dryers, water heaters, dishwashers, disposals and built-in microwaves, sized to each appliance and wired to code.

title: Bathroom Fixture Wiring
summary: Electrical for bathroom remodels and updates: vanity lights, exhaust fans vented to the outside, heated floors, towel warmers, wet-rated shower lights and GFCI-protected outlets.

title: Smart Home Wiring
summary: Wiring for smart switches, dimmers, thermostats, video doorbells, cameras and hubs, including adding neutral wires and power where devices need it, so your smart home is reliable rather than frustrating.

title: Smoke Detector Installation
summary: Hardwired, interconnected smoke and carbon monoxide alarms with battery backup, installed where code requires, plus replacement of alarms past their ten-year life and fixes for chirping and false alarms.

title: Doorbell Installation
summary: Wired and video doorbell installation, new transformers for Ring, Nest and other video doorbells, chime replacement and repair of doorbells that don't ring or keep losing power.

title: Low Voltage Wiring
summary: Network (Cat6) cable, thermostat and doorbell wire, speaker wire, TV wall pass-throughs and camera wiring, run neatly and kept a safe distance from power wiring.

title: Hot Tub Electrical Hookup
summary: Complete hot tub and swim spa wiring: a 240-volt circuit sized to the tub, a GFCI-protected disconnect at the required distance, bonding, the permit and the inspection.

title: Pool Electrical Wiring
summary: Electrical for in-ground and above-ground pools: pump, filter and heater circuits, pool lighting, equipotential bonding, GFCI protection and the inspections pools require.

title: Basement Wiring
summary: Complete electrical for finished basements: circuits, outlets, recessed lighting, AFCI and GFCI protection, smoke alarms, sump pump circuits and a subpanel if your main panel is full.

title: Shed, Garage & Barn Wiring
summary: Power for detached garages, sheds and workshops: underground feeders, subpanels, lighting, outlets, 240-volt tool circuits and EV charger circuits, permitted and inspected.

title: Barn Wiring
summary: Electrical for horse barns, pole buildings and agricultural outbuildings: feeders and subpanels, damp- and dust-rated lighting, GFCI-protected outlets, water heater and fan circuits, and old barn wiring replaced safely.

title: Electric Car Charger Installation
summary: Level 2 home EV charger installation by a Tesla-certified installer. We check your panel's capacity, run the circuit to your garage or driveway, and install and test chargers for Tesla, Rivian, Ford, Kia and other brands.

title: Ground Wire Installation & Repair
summary: Add ground wires to ungrounded outlets, repair or replace grounding electrodes and ground rods, and bond water pipes and gas lines, so your outlets, surge protection and electronics work as designed.

title: Recessed Lighting Installation
summary: Recessed LED lighting for kitchens, living rooms, basements and baths, laid out for even light without dark spots or glare, on dimmers, and installed in finished ceilings with minimal patching.

title: Light Fixture Installation
summary: Ceiling lights, chandeliers, pendants, wall sconces and track lighting, installed level, at the right height and on a box rated for the weight. We add new boxes and switches where there's no fixture today.

title: Ceiling Light Installation
summary: Replace dated ceiling fixtures or add a ceiling light to a room that doesn't have one. We check the box and wiring, support heavier fixtures properly and put it on the switch where you want it.

title: Chandelier Installation
summary: Chandeliers installed safely on supports rated for the weight, hung at the right height over the table or in a two-story foyer, assembled, leveled and put on a dimmer.

title: Pendant Lighting Installation
summary: Pendant lights over kitchen islands, peninsulas, dining tables and entries, spaced and hung at the right height, with new boxes where they're needed and adapters for sloped ceilings.

title: Wall Sconce Installation
summary: Wall sconces beside bathroom mirrors, along hallways and stairs, by the bed and at exterior doors, installed at the right height with new boxes fished into finished walls.

title: Track Lighting Installation
summary: Adjustable track and monorail lighting for artwork, kitchens, sloped ceilings, studios and retail displays, with modern LED heads you can aim, move and dim.

title: Under Cabinet Lighting Installation
summary: Hardwired LED under-cabinet lighting on a wall switch or dimmer, with the wiring and drivers hidden, so your counters are evenly lit without cords or dark spots.

title: Accent & Cove Lighting Installation
summary: Soft LED cove lighting in tray ceilings and crown molding, plus accent lighting for shelves, artwork, toe-kicks, stairs and built-ins, with hidden drivers and dimming.

title: LED Lighting Installation & Retrofits
summary: Convert fluorescent fixtures, old recessed cans, halogen and incandescent lighting to efficient LED, for homes and small businesses, including ballast bypass and full fixture replacement.

title: LED Strip Lighting Installation
summary: Hardwired LED strip (tape) lighting in aluminum channels with diffusers for coves, cabinets, shelves, stairs, bars and toe-kicks, with drivers sized for the run and hidden from view.

title: Smart Lighting Installation
summary: Smart switches and dimmers, scenes and schedules, app and voice control, installed with the neutrals and compatible fixtures they need, so your lighting is convenient and reliable.

title: Motion Sensor Lighting Installation
summary: Motion-activated lighting indoors and out: occupancy and vacancy sensor switches for closets, laundry rooms, garages and stairs, and outdoor motion lights for driveways, doors and walkways.

title: Security & Flood Light Installation
summary: LED floodlights and security lighting for driveways, yards, entrances and commercial lots, with motion sensors, dusk-to-dawn control and aiming that lights your property without blinding the neighbors.

title: Landscape & Low-Voltage Lighting Installation
summary: Low-voltage LED landscape lighting for paths, driveways, trees, steps, patios and the front of the house, with properly sized transformers, buried cable and timers or astronomical clocks.

title: Garage Lighting Installation
summary: Replace the single bare bulb with bright, even LED shop lighting, hardwired on a switch at the door, with added outlets and circuits for tools, freezers and workbenches.

title: Lighting Repair
summary: Fix lights that flicker, buzz or won't turn on, replace failed ballasts and drivers, change bulbs in hard-to-reach fixtures, and repair outdoor and landscape lighting.
